title: Alt-Tab not working when SSH session (PuTTYNG) is active
author: opbod
body_snippet:
**What happens** (and what you expected instead): alt-tab behavior not working as expected when an SSH session is opened (PuTTYNG.exe as part of mRemoteNG)). Expectation is that a single alt-tab changes between mRemoteNG and a different app.

**Steps to reproduce:**

1. Open mRemoteNG, open an SSH session
2. Alt-tab between mRemoteNG and another app
3. Observe mRemoteNG keeps on showing and requires at least 2 tabs to change to the other app. Clicking the mRemoteNG button on the taskbar requires...

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Thank you for the precise repro — "needs at least 2 Alt-Tabs" plus "taskbar needs multiple clicks" pointed straight at foreground-application state rather than keyboard focus.

Root cause found in our code: PuTTYNG is a separate process whose window we reparent into the mRemoteNG frame. Every time the embedded terminal was (re)focused, we called `SetForegroundWindow` on the PuTTY window — which makes **PuTTY's process** the foreground application in the eyes of the shell.
